summary: Implementation and static gates are complete and green, but the freeze/check closure cannot be truthfully completed: the Render PostgreSQL (Frankfurt) RTT is still degraded (p50 60-68ms vs ~27ms healthy baseline, recovery threshold p50<35ms not met). Per the completion-agent contract, inflated budgets must NOT be frozen on a degraded network, so no --freeze was executed and task551DatabaseBudgets.ts was left byte-identical to the previous agent's state (small=inflated-from-degradation, large=5/10/20ms placeholders). Concrete failures were captured instead: small --check fails (p95 76.75 > 71.1 on admin-pages-page) and the baseline test file is 11/12 (p95 spread 43.1% > 20%).
